title: Gomu Gomu no Mi
facts: Appearance (One Piece Wiki): a violet, spherical fruit similar to a cantaloupe, with a stem sprouting out of the top and swirls in a curly 'S'-like pattern; it greatly resembles a Yubari King melon
Officially classified as a Paramecia: the body becomes rubber (stretches; blunt hits and bullets bounce off; lightning can't hurt it)
Gear Second: pumps blood faster, the skin turns pink and steams, huge speed
Gear Third: blows air into the bones to make giant limbs (a giant fist)
Gear Fourth: inflates the muscles and coats them in Armament Haki; Boundman bounces around
Gear Fifth (awakening): hair and clothes turn white, cartoon-like freedom, can turn the surroundings into rubber
True name: Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika (Human-Human Fruit, Model: Nika); the World Government renamed it Gomu Gomu no Mi to hide it (Wano arc spoiler)
The Red-Haired Pirates attacked a World Government ship carrying the fruit; young Luffy ate it by accident as dessert at Partys Bar in Foosha Village (chapter 1 / Egghead flashback)
'Never need a ladder' is a joke line
